newsitem.title: USA: Netscape in major software alliance - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Netscape in major software alliance - NYT.

text.p: Netscape Communications Corp plans a software alliance with International Business Machines Corp and five other companies, The New York Times reported on Monday.
The company will announce on Monday that a software company it created has formed the alliance with IBM, Oracle Corp , Sony Corp, Nintendo Co Ltd, Sega Enterprises Ltd and NEC Corp.
The Netscape-led venture, called the Navio Corp, intends to develop refined software for browsing the Internet and a new software operating system.
Executives told the newspaper they hoped the system would become a standard means for controlling Internet access and basic operations for a broad range of consumer devices.
The company, founded this year, presents a counterpoint to the strategy that gave Microsoft its dominance in software for personal computers.

Netscape executives said consumers should eventually be able to choose between multiple-purpose personal computers and an array of consumer devices for specific tasks which will cost far less than a personal computer.
